name: gc_0930_candle_body2p5_15m

source.title: Owner's own idea, 2026-10-12: follow the 09:30 15-minute candle, stop at its extreme, target 0.75R

entry.words: Look at the 15-minute candle that opens at 09:30 ET (09:30-09:45). At its close, 09:45, enter at market in its direction: green = long, red = short, a doji or a candle whose body (open to close) is under 2.5 points = no trade. Stop at the candle's far extreme (its low for a long, its high for a short). Target 0.75 times the stop distance.

taught: 09:30 ET the 15-minute candle opens; at its close (09:45) enter in its direction
stop = the extreme of that candle on the far side (long: its low; short: its high)
one trade a day, flat by the engine's 15:58 ET if neither is hit
the candle's body must be at least 2.5 points, or no trade that day (owner 2026-10-12: try minimum sizes, adjusted per instrument)
